body:
Since December 2019, the federal minimum age to buy tobacco products, including e-cigarettes, has been 21 across the United States. For anyone buying vapor products online, that single number shapes everything from the age gate on the website to the signature on the doorstep. This guide explains what 21+ age verification means in practice at One Stop Vape Store: what you confirm when you arrive, what checkout asks, what happens at delivery, why the rules are strict, how higher age limits and local rules can apply, why we never sell to anyone under 21 and what to do if you are buying for someone else. It is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live.

## The federal minimum age
In December 2019, federal law raised the minimum age of sale for tobacco products, including e-cigarettes and other vapor products, to 21 nationwide. The change is often called Tobacco 21. It applies to sales in stores and online, and it applies regardless of any older state or local age. Some states and cities also have their own rules, which can be stricter. Whatever the local rule, no one under 21 may lawfully buy these products from us.

## At our age gate
Our site shows an age confirmation when you arrive. You confirm that you are 21 or older to enter the store. The gate also shows the nicotine warning and a link to our terms. This is a first step and a reminder, not the only check, because a click cannot prove age on its own. If you are under 21, you should choose the option that says so, and you will not be able to browse the shop.

## At checkout
When you place an order, you confirm again that you are 21 or older, and you provide your name and shipping address. We check the order for consistency, and orders may be reviewed. We can refuse or cancel any order that we cannot verify, or that we believe may be for a minor, and we will tell you why where we can. Providing false information is not just against our terms: it can be unlawful. See our [terms](/terms/) and [FDA disclaimer](/fda-disclaimer/).

## At delivery
This is the check that matters most. The carrier requires an adult aged 21 or older to sign for the package and to show valid government-issued photo ID. The ID must show the person's date of birth and be current. The delivery employee compares the ID with the delivery and records the details according to the carrier's procedures. A parcel is not left unattended, and it is not handed to a minor. If no adult is available, the carrier retries and then returns the parcel, and a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and shipping cost applies. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Why the rules are strict
Federal and state rules for remote vape sales require adult signature confirmation, and the aim is to keep age-restricted products away from minors. Online sales are especially sensitive, because the seller cannot see the buyer. That is why the law puts the final check on the delivery employee, who can see the person and the ID. The [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) explains the rule, and our [shipping policy](/shipping/) describes how we apply it.

## Higher age limits and other rules
Some places set rules that go beyond federal law. A state or city may set a higher minimum age, limit flavors, restrict quantities or require specific delivery arrangements. Others ban online sales of certain products altogether. Where a local rule is stricter than the federal one, the stricter rule applies. It is your responsibility to know the rules where you live. See [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/) and [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## Never buy for minors
Buying vapor products for anyone under 21 is illegal, even if the buyer is an adult. If you buy for someone under 21, you may be breaking the law, and the consequences can be serious. Keep products out of reach of children, teenagers and pets, and do not share them with anyone underage. See [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/). If you are under 21, you should not use this site.

## What if my ID looks different?
Carriers accept current, valid government-issued photo ID that shows your date of birth, such as a driver's license, a state ID or a passport. If your ID is expired or damaged, get a replacement before delivery. If your name differs from the one on the order, tell us in the order notes so that the carrier can match them. A delivery employee cannot waive the ID check.

## What if I am an adult buying for an adult?
You can ship to another adult's address, provided that adult is 21 or older and will sign with ID. Tell us in the order notes if the recipient's name differs from yours. Do not use our service to buy for anyone under 21 or for resale to minors.

## How we handle your information
We use the age confirmation and the order details for the purposes in our [privacy policy](/privacy/): fulfilling your order, meeting legal obligations and preventing fraud. We do not sell your information. The carrier checks your ID at the door, and we do not receive a copy of it. If we ever need further verification, we will explain why and how.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is clicking the age gate enough?
It is a first step. The checks at checkout and at delivery are what meet the legal requirements.

### What if I turn 21 next week?
Wait until you are 21. A purchase before then is not lawful, even if delivery would be after your birthday, because the sale takes place when you order.

### Do older states' rules, such as 18, still apply?
No. The federal minimum is 21 in every state. A state rule can be higher, but it cannot be lower.

### What if someone else signs for my parcel?
Only an adult aged 21 or older may sign, and they must show ID. If you are unsure of the rules for your carrier, check before delivery.

### Do you ever ask for a copy of my ID?
We confirm age through the age gate and checkout, and the carrier checks ID at delivery. If we need more, we will explain why and ask only through our official channels.

## Our policies
Read the [terms](/terms/) and the [FDA disclaimer](/fda-disclaimer/), and the [PACT Act FAQ](/pact-act/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) only if you are 21 or older. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A short history of the minimum age
Before December 2019, the federal minimum age to buy tobacco products was 18, and many states and cities had already raised it to 21. The federal change made 21 the national minimum, so that the rule is the same everywhere in the country. Retailers and online sellers had to update their processes, and carriers had to apply it to deliveries. If you remember a time when the age was 18, that is no longer the rule, and an older state rule that is lower than 21 no longer applies.

## What age verification does and does not do
Age verification is a set of checks, not a single step. The age gate and checkout confirmations are declarations by you, the delivery check is a verification by a person looking at your ID, and the law together aims at keeping products away from minors. No single step is perfect, which is why they are layered. If you are an adult, the process is a minor inconvenience, and it is part of what lets online sales of these products exist under the law.

## Being a responsible adult buyer
If you are 21 or older and buy these products, you are also responsible for what happens to them afterward. Store them where children and pets cannot reach them, do not give or sell them to anyone under 21 and dispose of devices and batteries responsibly. If you suspect that someone is buying for minors, do not take part. If you are worried about a young person using these products, support is available from healthcare professionals and from public health services.

## Frequently asked questions about the process
### Does the age gate store my date of birth?
No. The age gate records only that you confirmed you are 21 or older, in your own browser, so that it does not ask again each time. It does not ask for your date of birth.

### What if I clear my browser data?
The age gate will appear again the next time you visit, and your cart will be empty. Confirm your age again to continue.

### Can I be refused at delivery even if the order was accepted?
Yes. The carrier's check is separate. If the signer cannot show valid ID that confirms they are 21 or older, the carrier will not hand over the parcel.

### Does the age check apply to every product?
Yes. Every product on the site, including pouches, accessories and devices, is for adults aged 21 and over, and every delivery requires adult signature.
